verses.arabicText: يسٓ
verses.transliteration: Ya-seen
verses.translation: Yâ-Sĩn

verses.arabicText: وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Wal-qur'āni l-ḥakīm
verses.translation: By the Quran, rich in wisdom

verses.arabicText: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Innaka lamina l-mur'salīn
verses.translation: You ˹O Prophet˺ are truly one of the messengers

verses.arabicText: عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
verses.transliteration: ʿalā ṣirāṭim-mus'taqīmin
verses.translation: upon the Straight Path

verses.arabicText: تَنزِيلَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Tanzīla l-ʿazīzi r-raḥīm
verses.translation: ˹This is˺ a revelation from the Almighty, Most Merciful

verses.arabicText: لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًۭا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَٰفِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Litundhira qawmam-mā undhira ābāuhum fahum ghāfilūn
verses.translation: so that you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, and so are heedless

verses.arabicText: لَقَدْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Laqad ḥaqqa l-qawlu ʿalā aktharihim fahum lā yu'minūn
verses.translation: The decree ˹of torment˺ has already been justified against most of them, for they will never believe

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِىٓ أَعْنَٰقِهِمْ أَغْلَٰلًۭا فَهِىَ إِلَى ٱلْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ
verses.transliteration: Innā jaʿalnā fī aʿnāqihim aghlālan fahiya ilā l-adhqāni fahum muq'maḥūn
verses.translation: ˹It is as if˺ We have put shackles around their necks up to their chins, so their heads are forced up

verses.arabicText: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّۭا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّۭا فَأَغْشَيْنَٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wajaʿalnā min bayni aydīhim saddaw-wamin khalfihim saddan fa-aghshaynāhum fahum lā yub'ṣirūn
verses.translation: and have placed a barrier before them and a barrier behind them and covered them ˹all˺ up, so they fail to see ˹the truth˺

verses.arabicText: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wasawāon ʿalayhim a-andhartahum am lam tundhir'hum lā yu'minūn
verses.translation: It is the same whether you warn them or not—they will never believe

verses.arabicText: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَخَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍۢ وَأَجْرٍۢ كَرِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Innamā tundhiru mani ittabaʿa dh-dhik'ra wakhashiya r-raḥmāna bil-ghaybi fabashir'hu bimaghfiratiw-wa-ajrin karīmin
verses.translation: You can only warn those who follow the Reminder and are in awe of the Most Compassionate without seeing Him. So give them good news of forgiveness and an honourable reward

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا۟ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Innā naḥnu nuḥ'yī l-mawtā wanaktubu mā qaddamū waāthārahum wakulla shayin aḥṣaynāhu fī imāmim-mubīnin
verses.translation: It is certainly We Who resurrect the dead, and write what they send forth and what they leave behind. Everything is listed by Us in a perfect Record

verses.arabicText: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَآءَهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-iḍ'rib lahum mathalan aṣḥāba l-qaryati idh jāahā l-mur'salūn
verses.translation: Give them an example ˹O Prophet˺ of the residents of a town, when the messengers came to them

verses.arabicText: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Idh arsalnā ilayhimu ith'nayni fakadhabūhumā faʿazzaznā bithālithin faqālū innā ilaykum mur'salūn
verses.translation: We sent them two messengers, but they rejected both. So We reinforced ˹the two˺ with a third, and they declared, “We have indeed been sent to you ˹as messengers˺.”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū mā antum illā basharum-mith'lunā wamā anzala r-raḥmānu min shayin in antum illā takdhibūn
verses.translation: The people replied, “You are only humans like us, and the Most Compassionate has not revealed anything. You are simply lying!”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū rabbunā yaʿlamu innā ilaykum lamur'salūn
verses.translation: The messengers responded, “Our Lord knows that we have truly been sent to you

verses.arabicText: وَمَا عَلَيْنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.transliteration: Wamā ʿalaynā illā l-balāghu l-mubīn
verses.translation: And our duty is only to deliver ˹the message˺ clearly.”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا۟ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Qālū innā taṭayyarnā bikum la-il-lam tantahū lanarjumannakum walayamassannakum minnā ʿadhābun alīmun
verses.translation: The people replied, “We definitely see you as a bad omen for us. If you do not desist, we will certainly stone you ˹to death˺ and you will be touched with a painful punishment from us.”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ طَٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ ۚ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّسْرِفُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū ṭāirukum maʿakum a-in dhukkir'tum bal antum qawmum-mus'rifūn
verses.translation: The messengers said, “Your bad omen lies within yourselves. Are you saying this because you are reminded ˹of the truth˺? In fact, you are a transgressing people.”

verses.arabicText: وَجَآءَ مِنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌۭ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wajāa min aqṣā l-madīnati rajuluy-yasʿā qāla yāqawmi ittabiʿū l-mur'salīn
verses.translation: Then from the farthest end of the city a man came, rushing. He advised, “O my people! Follow the messengers

verses.arabicText: ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَن لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ أَجْرًۭا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Ittabiʿū mal-lā yasalukum ajraw-wahum muh'tadūn
verses.translation: Follow those who ask no reward of you, and are ˹rightly˺ guided

verses.arabicText: وَمَا لِىَ لَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wamā liya lā aʿbudu alladhī faṭaranī wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūn
verses.translation: And why should I not worship the One Who has originated me, and to Whom you will be returned

verses.arabicText: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ بِضُرٍّۢ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
verses.transliteration: A-attakhidhu min dūnihi ālihatan iy-yurid'ni r-raḥmānu biḍurril-lā tugh'ni ʿannī shafāʿatuhum shayaw-walā yunqidhūn
verses.translation: How could I take besides Him other gods whose intercession would not be of any benefit to me, nor could they save me if the Most Compassionate intended to harm me

verses.arabicText: إِنِّىٓ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
verses.transliteration: Innī idhal-lafī ḍalālim-mubīnin
verses.translation: Indeed, I would then be clearly astray

verses.arabicText: إِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَٱسْمَعُونِ
verses.transliteration: Innī āmantu birabbikum fa-is'maʿūn
verses.translation: I do believe in your Lord, so listen to me.”

verses.arabicText: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qīla ud'khuli l-janata qāla yālayta qawmī yaʿlamūn
verses.translation: ˹But they killed him, then˺ he was told ˹by the angels˺, “Enter Paradise!” He said, “If only my people knew

verses.arabicText: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِى رَبِّى وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Bimā ghafara lī rabbī wajaʿalanī mina l-muk'ramīn
verses.translation: of how my Lord has forgiven me, and made me one of the honourable.”

verses.arabicText: ۞ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِن جُندٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wamā anzalnā ʿalā qawmihi min baʿdihi min jundim-mina s-samāi wamā kunnā munzilīn
verses.translation: We did not send any soldiers from the heavens against his people after his death, nor did We need to

verses.arabicText: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ خَٰمِدُونَ
verses.transliteration: In kānat illā ṣayḥataw-wāḥidatan fa-idhā hum khāmidūn
verses.translation: All it took was one ˹mighty˺ blast, and they were extinguished at once

verses.arabicText: يَٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yāḥasratan ʿalā l-ʿibādi mā yatīhim mir-rasūlin illā kānū bihi yastahziūn
verses.translation: Oh pity, such beings! No messenger ever came to them without being mocked

verses.arabicText: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Alam yaraw kam ahlaknā qablahum mina l-qurūni annahum ilayhim lā yarjiʿūn
verses.translation: Have the deniers not considered how many peoples We destroyed before them who never came back to life again

verses.arabicText: وَإِن كُلٌّۭ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-in kullul-lammā jamīʿul-ladaynā muḥ'ḍarūn
verses.translation: Yet they will all be brought before Us

verses.arabicText: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّۭا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waāyatul-lahumu l-arḍu l-maytatu aḥyaynāhā wa-akhrajnā min'hā ḥabban famin'hu yakulūn
verses.translation: There is a sign for them in the dead earth: We give it life, producing grain from it for them to eat

verses.arabicText: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعْنَٰبٍۢ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ
verses.transliteration: Wajaʿalnā fīhā jannātim-min nakhīliw-wa-aʿnābin wafajjarnā fīhā mina l-ʿuyūn
verses.translation: And We have placed in it gardens of palm trees and grapevines, and caused springs to gush forth in it

verses.arabicText: لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Liyakulū min thamarihi wamā ʿamilathu aydīhim afalā yashkurūn
verses.translation: so that they may eat from its fruit, which they had no hand in making. Will they not then give thanks

verses.arabicText: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Sub'ḥāna alladhī khalaqa l-azwāja kullahā mimmā tunbitu l-arḍu wamin anfusihim wamimmā lā yaʿlamūn
verses.translation: Glory be to the One Who created all ˹things in˺ pairs—˹be it˺ what the earth produces, their genders, or what they do not know

verses.arabicText: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waāyatul-lahumu al-laylu naslakhu min'hu n-nahāra fa-idhā hum muẓ'limūn
verses.translation: There is also a sign for them in the night: We strip from it daylight, then—behold!—they are in darkness

verses.arabicText: وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّۢ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Wal-shamsu tajrī limus'taqarril-lahā dhālika taqdīru l-ʿazīzi l-ʿalīm
verses.translation: The sun travels for its fixed term. That is the design of the Almighty, All-Knowing

verses.arabicText: وَٱلْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلْعُرْجُونِ ٱلْقَدِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Wal-qamara qaddarnāhu manāzila ḥattā ʿāda kal-ʿur'jūni l-qadīm
verses.translation: As for the moon, We have ordained ˹precise˺ phases for it, until it ends up like an old, curved palm stalk

verses.arabicText: لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيْلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَكُلٌّۭ فِى فَلَكٍۢ يَسْبَحُونَ
verses.transliteration: Lā sh-shamsu yanbaghī lahā an tud'rika l-qamara walā al-laylu sābiqu n-nahāri wakullun fī falakiy-yasbaḥūn
verses.translation: It is not for the sun to catch up with the moon, nor does the night outrun the day. Each is travelling in an orbit of their own

verses.arabicText: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
verses.transliteration: Waāyatul-lahum annā ḥamalnā dhurriyyatahum fī l-ful'ki l-mashḥūn
verses.translation: Another sign for them is that We carried their ancestors ˹with Noah˺ in the fully loaded Ark

verses.arabicText: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wakhalaqnā lahum mim-mith'lihi mā yarkabūn
verses.translation: and created for them similar things to ride in

verses.arabicText: وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-in-nasha nugh'riq'hum falā ṣarīkha lahum walā hum yunqadhūn
verses.translation: If We willed, We could drown them: then no one would respond to their cries, nor would they be rescued—

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Illā raḥmatam-minnā wamatāʿan ilā ḥīnin
verses.translation: except by mercy from Us, allowing them enjoyment for a ˹little˺ while

verses.arabicText: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-idhā qīla lahumu ittaqū mā bayna aydīkum wamā khalfakum laʿallakum tur'ḥamūn
verses.translation: ˹Still they turn away˺ when it is said to them, “Beware of what is ahead of you ˹in the Hereafter˺ and what is behind you ˹of destroyed nations˺ so you may be shown mercy.”

verses.arabicText: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍۢ مِّنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wamā tatīhim min āyatim-min āyāti rabbihim illā kānū ʿanhā muʿ'riḍīn
verses.translation: Whenever a sign comes to them from their Lord, they turn away from it

verses.arabicText: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa-idhā qīla lahum anfiqū mimmā razaqakumu l-lahu qāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū anuṭ'ʿimu mal-law yashāu l-lahu aṭʿamahu in antum illā fī ḍalālim-mubīnin
verses.translation: And when it is said to them, “Donate from what Allah has provided for you,” the disbelievers say to the believers, “Why should we feed those whom Allah could have fed if He wanted to? You are clearly astray!”

verses.arabicText: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verses.translation: And they ask ˹the believers˺, “When will this threat come to pass, if what you say is true?”

verses.arabicText: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Mā yanẓurūna illā ṣayḥataw-wāḥidatan takhudhuhum wahum yakhiṣṣimūn
verses.translation: They must be awaiting a single Blast, which will seize them while they are ˹entrenched˺ in ˹worldly˺ disputes

verses.arabicText: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةًۭ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Falā yastaṭīʿūna tawṣiyataw-walā ilā ahlihim yarjiʿūn
verses.translation: Then they will not be able to make a ˹last˺ will, nor can they return to their own people

verses.arabicText: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wanufikha fī ṣ-ṣūri fa-idhā hum mina l-ajdāthi ilā rabbihim yansilūn
verses.translation: The Trumpet will be blown ˹a second time˺, then—behold!—they will rush from the graves to their Lord

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū yāwaylanā man baʿathanā mim-marqadinā hādhā mā waʿada r-raḥmānu waṣadaqa l-mur'salūn
verses.translation: They will cry, “Woe to us! Who has raised us up from our place of rest? This must be what the Most Compassionate warned us of; the messengers told the truth!”

verses.arabicText: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: In kānat illā ṣayḥataw-wāḥidatan fa-idhā hum jamīʿul-ladaynā muḥ'ḍarūn
verses.translation: It will only take one Blast, then at once they will all be brought before Us

verses.arabicText: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌۭ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fal-yawma lā tuẓ'lamu nafsun shayaw-walā tuj'zawna illā mā kuntum taʿmalūn
verses.translation: On that Day no soul will be wronged in the least, nor will you be rewarded except for what you used to do

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍۢ فَٰكِهُونَ
verses.transliteration: Inna aṣḥāba l-janati l-yawma fī shughulin fākihūn
verses.translation: Indeed, on that Day the residents of Paradise will be busy enjoying themselves

verses.arabicText: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
verses.transliteration: Hum wa-azwājuhum fī ẓilālin ʿalā l-arāiki muttakiūn
verses.translation: They and their spouses will be in ˹cool˺ shade, reclining on ˹canopied˺ couches

verses.arabicText: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Lahum fīhā fākihatuw-walahum mā yaddaʿūn
verses.translation: There they will have fruits and whatever they desire

verses.arabicText: سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْلًۭا مِّن رَّبٍّۢ رَّحِيمٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Salāmun qawlam-min rabbir-raḥīmin
verses.translation: And “Peace!” will be ˹their˺ greeting from the Merciful Lord

verses.arabicText: وَٱمْتَٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-im'tāzū l-yawma ayyuhā l-muj'rimūn
verses.translation: ˹Then the disbelievers will be told,˺ “Step away ˹from the believers˺ this Day, O wicked ones

verses.arabicText: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Alam aʿhad ilaykum yābanī ādama al-lā taʿbudū sh-shayṭāna innahu lakum ʿaduwwum-mubīnun
verses.translation: Did I not command you, O Children of Adam, not to follow Satan, for he is truly your sworn enemy

verses.arabicText: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa-ani uʿ'budūnī hādhā ṣirāṭum-mus'taqīmun
verses.translation: but to worship Me ˹alone˺? This is the Straight Path

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّۭا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad aḍalla minkum jibillan kathīran afalam takūnū taʿqilūn
verses.translation: Yet he already misled great multitudes of you. Did you not have any sense

verses.arabicText: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Hādhihi jahannamu allatī kuntum tūʿadūn
verses.translation: This is the Hell you were warned of

verses.arabicText: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Iṣ'lawhā l-yawma bimā kuntum takfurūn
verses.translation: Burn in it Today for your disbelief.”

verses.arabicText: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Al-yawma nakhtimu ʿalā afwāhihim watukallimunā aydīhim watashhadu arjuluhum bimā kānū yaksibūn
verses.translation: On this Day We will seal their mouths, their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify to what they used to commit

verses.arabicText: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walaw nashāu laṭamasnā ʿalā aʿyunihim fa-is'tabaqū ṣ-ṣirāṭa fa-annā yub'ṣirūn
verses.translation: Had We willed, We could have easily blinded their eyes, so they would struggle to find their way. How then could they see

verses.arabicText: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّۭا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walaw nashāu lamasakhnāhum ʿalā makānatihim famā is'taṭāʿū muḍiyyaw-walā yarjiʿūn
verses.translation: And had We willed, We could have transfigured them on the spot, so they could neither progress forward nor turn back

verses.arabicText: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waman-nuʿammir'hu nunakkis'hu fī l-khalqi afalā yaʿqilūn
verses.translation: And whoever We grant a long life, We reverse them in development. Will they not then understand

verses.arabicText: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ وَقُرْءَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wamā ʿallamnāhu sh-shiʿ'ra wamā yanbaghī lahu in huwa illā dhik'ruw-waqur'ānun mubīnun
verses.translation: We have not taught him poetry, nor is it fitting for him. This ˹Book˺ is only a Reminder and a clear Quran

verses.arabicText: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّۭا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Liyundhira man kāna ḥayyaw-wayaḥiqqa l-qawlu ʿalā l-kāfirīn
verses.translation: to warn whoever is ˹truly˺ alive and fulfil the decree ˹of torment˺ against the disbelievers

verses.arabicText: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَٰمًۭا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ
verses.transliteration: Awalam yaraw annā khalaqnā lahum mimmā ʿamilat aydīnā anʿāman fahum lahā mālikūn
verses.translation: Do they not see that We singlehandedly created for them, among other things, cattle which are under their control

verses.arabicText: وَذَلَّلْنَٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wadhallalnāhā lahum famin'hā rakūbuhum wamin'hā yakulūn
verses.translation: And We have subjected these ˹animals˺ to them, so they may ride some and eat others

verses.arabicText: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walahum fīhā manāfiʿu wamashāribu afalā yashkurūn
verses.translation: And they derive from them other benefits and drinks. Will they not then give thanks

verses.arabicText: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi ālihatal-laʿallahum yunṣarūn
verses.translation: Still they have taken other gods besides Allah, hoping to be helped ˹by them˺

verses.arabicText: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّحْضَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Lā yastaṭīʿūna naṣrahum wahum lahum jundum-muḥ'ḍarūn
verses.translation: They cannot help the pagans, even though they serve the idols as dedicated guards

verses.arabicText: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Falā yaḥzunka qawluhum innā naʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿ'linūn
verses.translation: So do not let their words grieve you ˹O Prophet˺. Indeed, We ˹fully˺ know what they conceal and what they reveal

verses.arabicText: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Awalam yara l-insānu annā khalaqnāhu min-nuṭ'fatin fa-idhā huwa khaṣīmum-mubīnun
verses.translation: Do people not see that We have created them from a sperm-drop, then—behold!—they openly challenge ˹Us˺

verses.arabicText: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًۭا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Waḍaraba lanā mathalaw-wanasiya khalqahu qāla may-yuḥ'yī l-ʿiẓāma wahiya ramīmun
verses.translation: And they argue with Us—forgetting they were created—saying, “Who will give life to decayed bones?”

verses.arabicText: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.transliteration: Qul yuḥ'yīhā alladhī ansha-ahā awwala marratiw-wahuwa bikulli khalqin ʿalīmun
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “They will be revived by the One Who produced them the first time, for He has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of every created being

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًۭا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Alladhī jaʿala lakum mina sh-shajari l-akhḍari nāran fa-idhā antum min'hu tūqidūn
verses.translation: ˹He is the One˺ Who gives you fire from green trees, and—behold!—you kindle ˹fire˺ from them

verses.arabicText: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Awalaysa alladhī khalaqa s-samāwāti wal-arḍa biqādirin ʿalā ay-yakhluqa mith'lahum balā wahuwa l-khalāqu l-ʿalīm
verses.translation: Can the One Who created the heavens and the earth not ˹easily˺ resurrect these ˹deniers˺?” Yes ˹He can˺! For He is the Master Creator, All-Knowing

verses.arabicText: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.transliteration: Innamā amruhu idhā arāda shayan ay-yaqūla lahu kun fayakūn
verses.translation: All it takes, when He wills something ˹to be˺, is simply to say to it: “Be!” And it is

verses.arabicText: فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fasub'ḥāna alladhī biyadihi malakūtu kulli shayiw-wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūn
verses.translation: So glory be to the One in Whose Hands is the authority over all things, and to Whom ˹alone˺ you will ˹all˺ be returned
